exposure: Context-specific risk factors for preterm birth
outcome: Deaths from complications of preterm birth
cohort: The study reviews global data on newborns and children under 5 worldwide.
finding: There has been no measurable change in global preterm birth rates in the past decade, with an estimated 13.4 million (9.9% of births) newborns born preterm in 2020, and preterm birth complications remaining the top cause of under-5 child mortality globally.
mod_finding: Non-medically indicated caesarean sections are identified as a driver of provider-initiated preterm births that could be addressed to accelerate prevention efforts.
